這個倉由上游機械同步、每版整份覆蓋，PR 不會在 GitHub 直接合併：維護者審過後把改動移回上游、隨下一個版本發布，再在這裡留言註明收進哪一版並關閉 PR（詳見 CONTRIBUTING.md）。
This repository is generated from upstream and overwritten on every release, so PRs are not merged here: after review the maintainer moves the change upstream, ships it with the next release, then comments here with that version and closes the PR (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
-->
